title: Graceful shutdown
hints: srv.Close drops every open connection at once, including requests still being handled. srv.Shutdown stops accepting new connections and waits for in-flight requests to finish.
Run srv.Serve(ln) in a goroutine that sends its error on a buffered channel. Wait for either that error or <-ctx.Done().

On cancellation, call srv.Shutdown with a context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), grace) and then read Serve's result. http.ErrServerClosed is what Serve always returns after Shutdown, so treat it as success and return nil.
